purpose: Test whether current-official EWoK negative treatment interactions align with compact-view semantic hazard flags before authorizing force-repair training.

scientific_read.directness: This is heuristic: compact corpus domain tags are broad and do not prove that a particular EWoK item was learned from a particular row. It only tests whether the proposed repair's flags are enriched in the domains where official EWoK DiD is negative.
scientific_read.use: A strong positive alignment between hazard burden and negative DiD would support materializing a force-repair corpus; weak or opposite alignment would favor checkpoint/optimization/consolidation work or a different relation-domain data idea.
